question: Anu, Mehak, Riya, Divya, and Leena are five friends. Anu is twice as old as Mehak. Riya is half the age of Mehak. Anu is half the age of Divya and Riya is twice the age of Leena. Who is the youngest?
solution: Five friends Anu, Mehak, Riya, Divya, and Leena We consider 'x' 1) Anu is twice as old as Mehak so we put 'x' for Mehak and consider '2x' (twice) for Anu. 2) Riya is half the age of Mehak The age of Mehak is 'x' so we consider 'xover2' for Riya. 3) Anu is half the age of Divya
